note: The approved WilliamOS fabric callers of the authority oracle. This file is the single declared source for BOTH policy layers: pg_hba.conf's host lines and apply-network-policy.sh's DOCKER-USER allowlist. Adding a caller means editing this file and re-running the apply script; there is no other supported way in.

callers.reason: The control plane. It runs the WilliamOS runtime that serves app/api/system/node/stamp-identity and every other governed route whose authority leg reads this registry. It is the only node that consults the authority oracle.
callers.addressStability: DHCP -- see CONT-EXPV2-ALLOWLIST-ADDRESS-BOUND. An L3 allowlist can only name addresses, so this entry does not survive a lease change on its own; the owner's DHCP reservations are what make it durable.

deliberatelyExcluded.reason: Cockpit only. It reaches WilliamOS through the runtime on HERMES (https://192.168.88.9:3443), never the authority registry directly. It is retained here as the negative control: a LAN host that must be refused.
Execution worker. It receives brokered commands; it does not evaluate authority.
The host itself. Administration is docker exec over the container's unix socket, which the pg_hba `local` line already covers and which no network grant is needed for.
